counsel for appellants as well as Sri.Subhash J.Baddi, learned counsel for respondent No.2 are
present.

2. This appeal is filed by the claimants in M.V.C. No.1100/2020 which stood pending before the
Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal' for
brevity) and was disposed of through orders dated 04.01.2022.
3.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On this day, both the learned counsel filed joint memo reporting settlement.

As per the contents of the said memo, respondent No.2 agreed to pay a sum of Rs.4,10,000/- in addition to the sum that has been awarded by the Tribunal and the appellants agreed to receive the same towards full and final settlement of the claim.

The NC: 2025:KHC-D:15092 HC-KAR contents of the memo also reveal that respondent No.2 agreed to deposit the enhanced sum before the Tribunal within a period of six weeks, failing which, he undertakes to pay interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the date of default till the date of deposit.

4. Having considered the agreement arrived at between both the parties, the appeal is disposed of with the following:
ORDER (i) The compensation that is granted by the Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi through orders in M.V.C. No.1100/2020 dated 04.01.2022 is enhanced by Rs.4,10,000/-.
(ii) Respondent No.2 to deposit the enhanced sum within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
NC: 2025:KHC-D:15092 HC-KAR (iii) Failure on part of respondent No.2 to deposit within the time granted will result in payment of interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the date of default till the date of deposit.
(iv) Out of the enhanced sum, appellant No.1 is entitled to a sum of Rs.3,20,000/- and appellants No.2 to 4 a sum of Rs.30,000/- each.
(v) On such deposit, appellants are permitted to withdraw their respective shares.
